Null specification S3 class

Source: R/null_spec.R
null_spec.Rd

A neurothresh_null_spec is the common handle for supported permutation-based inference methods. hier_scan() does not yet support supplied nulls. It bundles the observed (canonicalized) statistic map, the mask used to build the null, a deterministic-by-index draw function, and metadata describing the resampling design.

Details

Factories that return neurothresh_null_spec objects: null_voxel_signflip(), null_subject_signflip(), null_one_sample(), null_two_sample(), null_glm(), null_mc_fwhm(), null_mc_acf(), null_parcel_perm().

Slots

stat_vol

Observed Z-equivalent statistic map (3D array or NeuroVol).

mask

Logical mask (3D array or LogicalNeuroVol).

draw

function(b) returning a length-sum(mask) numeric vector for permutation index 1 <= b <= n_perm. Deterministic by index.

n_perm

Maximum supported draws (integer).

df

Degrees of freedom (numeric, may be NA).

kind

One of "voxel_signflip", "subject_signflip", "one_sample", "two_sample", "glm", "mc_fwhm", "mc_acf", "parcel_perm".

meta

Free-form named list of method-specific metadata (smoothness, design matrix, perm indices, etc.).
